description: This is a unit test class for ImmutableFeatureFromCopyBuilder, testing various builder methods, property copying, and null handling in the context of features within the org.eclipse.ditto.model.things package.

classes.name: ImmutableFeatureFromCopyBuilderTest
classes.description: Unit test class for ImmutableFeatureFromCopyBuilder, testing feature building, null inputs, and property copying behaviors.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test instance before each test case.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceOfNullFeature
methods.description: Tests that passing null to builder creates throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: builderOfFeatureIsCorrectlyInitialised
methods.description: Verifies that the builder initialized with a feature creates an equal feature object.

methods.name: featurePropertiesNullGivesNullFeature
methods.description: Checks that null properties result in a feature with default definitions.

methods.name: jsonObjectNullGivesNullFeature
methods.description: Checks that null JSON object yields a default feature.

methods.name: copyFeatureAndModifyProperties
methods.description: Tests the copying of feature properties and their modification.
